name: force-bed-mesh-adaptive
title: Force Adaptive Bed Mesh
description: Forces an adaptive bed mesh before every print: it probes only the part of the bed your model uses, so leveling is faster while still accurate where it matters. Falls back to a full mesh when your slicer hasn't sent object boundaries, so enable 'Exclude Object' in your slicer for the full benefit. Pick this OR Force Bed Mesh, not both. Snapmaker U1 only.
tagline: Mesh just the area your model covers, before each print.
